g.text: Two hosts: now the same trick fails
docker0 exists only inside each machine, and both machines use the same addresses.
Container 1 has no path to a container on another
host: docker0 is local to each machine.
Both containers may be 172.17.0.2. Which one is meant?
Each container sits behind its own host's NAT, so
nobody can start a connection to it.
We want containers on different hosts to talk as if they were on ONE switch. That is what an overlay network provides.
